kind: live app (capabilities: db, assets, downloads, mcp → Claude Code Remote create_session) — NOT a static page since 2026-09-26
note: Data flows through the artifact DATABASE (ArtifactData tool), not HTML edits. Republishing brand/dashboard.html is only for design/behavior changes; pass url and OMIT capabilities to keep them (a non-empty capabilities object is a full-set declaration — restate all four). Fired sessions must READ the artifact before their first republish of it. Layout since 2026-09-27: four tabs (Today = numbered to-dos derived from queue docs + meta/board.tasks, and money; Clips = ready/being made/posted cards with per-platform rows; Campaigns; YouTube).

db_schema.campaigns/<config id>: tracked campaign: {name, org, rate:str, rem:usd, bud:usd, flag: ok|hold|dead, can_queue:bool, url (submit link), note, rules:[chips], sources_state, updated:ms}
db_schema.queue/<id>:
{campaign_id, campaign_name, title (≤40 chars), note, status: queued|producing|ready|posted|killed, created:ms, updated:ms, claimed_by, kill_reason, ledger_id, allowed:[tiktok|instagram|youtube], skip_submit:bool, skip_reason, platforms:{

:{status: posted|submitted|skipped, url, at:ms, submitted_at:ms}} (written by the board's 'I posted it' / 'I submitted it' / Skip), drafts:{tiktok|youtube:{status: requested|preparing|uploading|awaiting_approval|uploaded|in_inbox|check_inbox|failed|needs_setup, requested_at:ms, session_id, session_url, expires_at:ISO, publish_session_id, video_url, youtube_id, studio_url, error}} (Approve flow, docs/PRODUCE-QUEUE.md §7), clip:{name,length_s,asset_url:'/_blob/',delivery}, package:{caption, caption_ig, yt_title, yt_description, window, ai_label, audio, submit_url, checklist:[str], tiktok_draft:{video_url,...legacy}}; legacy: post_url, posted_at}
db_schema.meta/board: {stamp, followers, hearts, stats_at, floor_label, updated:ms, updated_by, tasks:[{id, text ≤60 chars, sub ≤110 chars, tab?, done?}] (manual to-dos shown after the clip-derived ones; the board marks done), lanes:{env_id?, model?, youtube_drafts:bool, youtube_connected:bool, youtube_connect_url} (Approve-flow settings; override page defaults). do_next is RETIRED (deleted 2026-09-27) — write tasks instead}
db_schema.campaigns/cr-<8 of uuid>: DISCOVERED by whop_scout.py board-feed (work/whop/board-feed.json): same fields + {discovered:true, first_seen:'YYYY-MM-DD' (from config/discovered-seen.json), cr_campaign_id, money:{rate, per10k, min_payout, max_payout, pays_from_views, burn_per_day, runway_days, score}}; board sorts tracked first, then by money.score; NEW chip for 3 days
db_schema.posts/<ledger id>: from scripts/tiktok_stats.py (work/tiktok/stats.json): {clip, campaign_id, posted:'MM-DD', views, likes, comments, accruing:usd, pays_from:views, payable:bool, state: go|ok|dead|wait, note, post_url, updated:ms}
